snap_sooner.rule: Snap ON at the last frame before crossing, held every frame through crossing, off only when arms are clear. Torso < arm < head for chest crossing.

detail.note: Whole arm chain per object; no forearm/fist was keyed separately from its upper arm.

detail.rule: Knee direction == toe direction, per frame, both legs; exception only for a Mars-named specific pose.
Feet planted unless the shot is labelled airborne; planted foot within 5 px of ground.

wrist.detail: No armature object in this blend; wrist gate needs the rig's bone data.
